description: This PHP source file defines a class 'HTTP_WebDAV_Server_iCal' that extends a WebDAV server implementation to handle iCalendar (iCal) requests over WebDAV. It manages calendar data retrieval, serving iCal and free/busy information, and handles user authentication and request parsing for calendar access.

classes.name: HTTP_WebDAV_Server_iCal
classes.description: A class that provides WebDAV-based access to calendar data in iCal format, including serving calendar files, handling authentication, and serving free/busy information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WebDAV server, creates an iCal instance, and a user focus bean.

methods.name: ServeICalRequest
methods.description: Main method to process incoming WebDAV iCal requests, parse parameters, authenticate user, and prepare for serving data.

methods.name: http_GET
methods.description: Handles the HTTP GET request, serving the iCal or free/busy data if authorized, setting HTTP headers appropriately.

methods.name: http_status
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response status and headers.
